target: KKS / Unity 2019.4.9f1 runtime / Built-in Forward / D3D11 / KKSLinear-v1
colorContract: Color constants below are LINEAR RGB; ColorValueMode=2. Color maps keep host Auto. No textures, keywords, carrier assets or shader defaults are changed.

profiles.description: Recommended live configuration. No automatic POM, glints, tessellation, film or coat activation. Half-resolution glass request; another visible Full requester can raise the shared allocation.

Explicit manual material copy, not an automatic global quality switch. Area Reference and Full glass; film stays Realtime. POM Reference is dormant until an author enables POM. Restore the live material after capture.

presets.cost: Low relative to this family; native-light count and fill still matter.
presets.notes: Opaque pigmented plastic, IOR 1.5. Neutral missing maps use these constants. No coat, film, glints or relief.

presets.cost: Low to medium; needs actual environment radiance to show environment reflections.
presets.notes: Warm copper-like fitted RGB F0, not measured spectral copper. Metallic=1 removes painted diffuse. No environment means no invented reflection.

presets.cost: Medium; anisotropic direct BRDF and approximate IBL, more expensive with rectangles.
presets.notes: UV-tangent brushing. Rotation is degrees, strength map defaults white, rotation map black. Requires usable UV/tangent data; not a procedural scratch texture.

presets.cost: Medium to high; complete coat transport per native light, and layered rectangle MIS when active.
presets.notes: Red pigmented substrate plus clear coat, not a complete automotive paint BSDF. Statistical substrate glints are available as an explicit opt-in, but default off; no separate measured metallic-flake layer is claimed.

presets.cost: High even in Realtime; very high with multiple native lights, mixed metals or rectangle Reference.
presets.notes: Dark dielectric substrate demonstrates interference color more clearly than high-F0 white metal. Interfering interface UNDER coat. Film nm and coat mm are different distances. Both profile copies keep optimized ThinFilmQuality=0; select 1 manually only for bounded reference comparisons.

presets.cost: Medium to high: transmission plus reflection passes, overdraw and optional shared color/depth copies; nine-tap finite rough transmission.
presets.notes: 6 mm local parallel slab, green-tinted Beer absorption defined at 5 cm. Full coverage, not alpha-faded glass. Scene refraction requires Companion >=0.5; without it, unshifted RGB transmission and surface reflection remain. No colored shadow caster or exact GGX BTDF.

geometryPolicy: Guidance only, not applied to these plain BSDF/Glass presets or switched automatically. Author a mesh-specific HeightScale, matching mip and seam mask; use Tess entries instead of same-layer POM. Zero height removes relief but not the fixed hull/domain pipeline.
